comments.author: Orakio
comments.body:
Note that when collecting, you can also turn common grass in vegetable oil with the Craftsman's training book.

At Nantes outskirts, by my experience, the collection points give:

Southwest Stacked boulders:
30% - vegetable oil
40% - common grass
30% - hemp
20% - fenel

Lone Cedar
12% - vegetable oil
73% - common grass
10% - hemp
5% - fenel

East Stacked boulders:
10% - vegetable oil
74% - common grass
10% - hemp
6% - fenel
